Six workflows re-run a gate that already blocks locally

label: 32 workflows plus README; 13 of the 32 carry no paths filter and queue on every push and PR
Six CI workflows re-run a gate that already blocks locally: comment-hygiene, prompt-card-sync, agent-mirror-sync, message-contract, routing-registry-drift, naming-standard-guard
Duplicate workflows pay for setup not checking: comment-hygiene fetches 13633 commits (2.01 GiB pack) for a 0.09s checker; agent-mirror-sync runs npm ci plus a tsc build for a 0.13s checker
17 of 32 workflows install dependencies before a script-level check; naming-standard-guard installs pytest 8.4.2 for a filename check
naming-standard-guard.yml is the cleanest delete: the push hook deleted its naming gate because the remote-permission gate already covered it
message-contract.yml is not a straight delete: its CI body adds a node:test of the validator and PR-description checks that do not exist at push time
routing-registry-drift.yml (357 lines, 23 steps) is not a plain duplicate: it sees the pushed commit where the local gate sees only the working tree
